The idea

What if a runner felt like low orbit?

ORBIT-1 starts from a simple thought: a shoe that looks like it is already moving when it stands still. The midsole is sculpted as one continuous wave, the upper is a single knitted skin, and the outsole breaks into free-floating pods.

Every line on this page, the shoe itself, the art direction and the code were produced as a one-person studio exercise, using AI tools for the heavy lifting. It exists to show what a modern solo creative agency can ship.

How it was made

One person, one weekend, one AI stack.

The shoe design, the 3D-style renders, the words and this website were all produced by a solo studio with AI doing the production work: concept imagery, art direction and front-end code. This is the agency model of the next decade, compressed into a single page.

ORBIT-1 is an unofficial concept study. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Nike, Inc. Nike is a trademark of Nike, Inc. The shoe design, imagery and words on this page are original concept work created for portfolio purposes only. Nothing here is for sale.
